title: Jukskei
tagline: Throw the skei, read the wind, knock the stake.
description: A South African throwing sport, seen from the side: pick Lob, Skim or Whirl, place the ring, time your release and send a flat wooden pin down the sand lane at the stake. Four lanes, six rivals, a league ladder and pass-and-play.
howToPlay: Press the sand to place the gold ring where the pin should land.
Pick Lob, Skim or Whirl: the ghost pin shows where it ends up.
Check the wind box, then press Throw and Release in the green.
Knock the stake for 3, touch it for 2, land within a metre for 1.
After eight pins the nearest one earns a bonus point.
